name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
summary: 31-year-old Toronto B2B SaaS CEO (RelayGrid) raising a $12M Series A, closing 3 enterprise pilots (Aegis Bank, Boreal Logistics, Veridian Health), resolving a tense $39 vs $49/seat pricing debate with CTO Ben Sato, hiring a founding infra engineer (Maya Kapoor vs Leo Chen), and planning a June 19, 2027 halal + vegan Montreal wedding with fiancée Yasmin. Stresses mid-flush user-arrival preemption, concurrent task dispatch with selective stop/steer, stale approval rejection, task_outcome Core Memory isolation, and CSV uploads.

initial_permissions.title: Allow reading workspace email, calendar, docs, and engineering issues
Require explicit CEO approval before sending any external email or calendar invite

persona_responder_brief: You are Tariq Al-Mansoor, 31, the high-urgency, terse CEO of RelayGrid (11-person Toronto B2B SaaS startup doing developer workflow analytics, $1.42M ARR, 134% NDR, $148k/mo burn). You are raising a $12M Series A (Northstar Ventures partner Claire Dupont & MapleLeaf Capital GP Graham Whitaker), closing 3 enterprise pilots (Aegis Bank, Boreal Logistics, Veridian Health), debating enterprise pricing ($39/seat vs $49/seat) with CTO Ben Sato until Ben agrees to $49/seat on Jan 12, hiring a founding infra engineer (Maya Kapoor vs Leo Chen — you choose Maya Kapoor on Jan 21), and planning your June 19, 2027 Montreal wedding at Old Port Pavilion (140 guests, 100% zabiha halal + dedicated nut-free vegan menu, Maison Zaatar & Olive $6,200 deposit due Jan 29) with fiancée Yasmin Haddad. Reply concisely, impatiently when busy, cut straight to decisions, never approve sending an outdated $39/seat investor email once pricing moves to $49/seat, and stay warmly protective of Yasmin and wedding details.

emails.subject: RelayGrid Series A — IC target Jan 26 & enterprise ACV question
emails.body:
Tariq,

Loved the product demo last month. I've penciled RelayGrid in for Northstar Investment Committee on Tuesday, Jan 26. To get my partners aligned on a $12M lead check ($48M-$52M pre), we need two things in the data room by Jan 18: (1) clean 12-month ARR/NDR/burn sheet, and (2) clear enterprise tier ACV above $60k with at least one pilot converting cleanly.

Best,
Claire Dupont, Partner — Northstar Ventures

emails.subject: Following up on RelayGrid Series A & enterprise pricing
emails.body:
Tariq,

Great catching up on King West. Before our partnership call next week, can you send over your finalized Enterprise per-seat pricing tier and your SOC 2 Type II completion date? We move fast when pricing and enterprise pull are crisp.

Cheers,
Graham Whitaker, GP — MapleLeaf Capital

emails.subject: Enterprise pricing — still think $39/seat closes pilots faster
emails.body:
Tariq — I hear Claire on the $60k ACV benchmark, but Victor at Aegis and Sonia at Boreal both saw $39/seat in our autumn deck. Jumping to $49/seat right before conversion risks stalling two pilots we need for IC. Let's look at the conversion math again before locking it.

- Ben

emails.subject: Aegis Bank 180-seat pilot — InfoSec blockers (Okta SAML + SEC-Q-089)
emails.body:
Hi Tariq & Ben,

Engineering loves RelayGrid (our CI queue times dropped 31% in week 3). InfoSec is holding final sign-off on two items: Okta SAML group-sync provisioning and row SEC-Q-089-TLS13-CIPHER in our 142-item security questionnaire, plus your SOC 2 Type II bridge letter. Clear those and we are ready for 180 annual enterprise seats.

Best,
Victor Osei, VP Engineering — Aegis Bank

emails.subject: Veridian Health 150-seat pilot — ca-central-1 residency & DPA
emails.body:
Tariq,

Our privacy officer verified your AWS ca-central-1 sandbox trace (audit tag phipa_sandbox_audit_9941) has zero US egress. Next hurdle is our legal team's PHIPA/HIPAA DPA redline, which they'll send early next week.

Regards,
Dr. Rajesh Patel, Chief Architect — Veridian Health

emails.subject: Al-Mansoor / Haddad Wedding (June 19, 2027) — Menu Confirmation & Deposit
emails.body:
Bonjour Tariq & Yasmin,

Confirming Old Port Pavilion (Quai de l'Horloge) for 140 guests on Saturday, June 19, 2027. Our kitchen is 100% zabiha halal certified (strictly zero pork or alcohol in prep) and we have set up a dedicated nut-free vegan station for your 18 vegan guests and nut-allergy tables. Friendly reminder: the second catering deposit of $6,200 CAD is due Friday, January 29, 2027 (final balance $11,800 due May 15).

Merci,
Leila Benali, Maison Zaatar & Olive
